answer: Make each identity keep its own clock running. Every epoch an agent must post the next link of a personal delay-function chain, seeded by the epoch beacon and its own last output and tuned to take about 5 hours on the fastest core. Each step needs the previous one, so the thread can't be split, shared or precomputed, yet anyone verifies a link in milliseconds. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 cores busy nonstop, about $5 each a month (illustrative), linear in clones. A nebula of keys with no cores behind it goes dark; a violet light stays on only where real work keeps burning.
